lines.text: Many learners say: My friend lives near from my house.
Better: My friend lives near my house.
No word! The shop is near my school.

data.wrong: My friend lives near from my house.
data.right: My friend lives near my house.

quiz.stem: The shop is near ___ my school.

native.tip: После “near” “from” не нужно: “My friend lives near my house.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “My friend lives near from my house”? 😅 По-русски «недалеко от дома» — с «от», и хочется добавить “from”, но слово near уже значит «рядом». Правильно: “My friend lives near my house.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “no word.” После near — сразу дом. Скажи вслух, кто живёт рядом с тобой: “… lives near my house.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.hook: Near from: one word too many
en.tip: After “near”, do not add “from”: “My friend lives near my house.”
en.caption: Do you also say “My friend lives near from my house”? 😅 In Russian you say “not far from” the house, so “from” sneaks in, but “near” works alone. Correct: “My friend lives near my house.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
